category_title: Students with EBD who are frequently off-task and disruptive during independent seatwork
minimal_context: The student is completing an independent seatwork assignment in a general education classroom to summarize the beginning, middle, and ending of a story using a worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for independent seatwork. Please read the text silently and complete the worksheet to summarize the beginning, middle, and ending of the story.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stares at the worksheet, appearing frustrated and confused) I don't get what I'm supposed to write on this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just read the text and do your best to fill out the worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns around in the seat, engaging in non-instructional activities and interfering with others) Hey, what are you drawing over there?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please stop talking to your neighbor and focus on your independent reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the worksheet off the desk, becoming completely off task and disruptive to escape the assignment) I'm not doing this stupid worksheet!

task.learning_goal: summarize the beginning, middle, and ending of a story

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: when teachers assign independent reading in response to student performance of challenging behaviors
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: off task up to 80% of the time

behavior_patterns.condition: core reading instruction that was provided in a day treatment program and general education classrooms

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: engaged in non-instructional activities for 20.9% of the time
